tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement DeliveryService - write stock ledger entry on delivery
tasks.description: DeliveryService currently only has stub create(). Implement full service: write stock ledger entry on delivery, handle tank stock updates, append-only ledger compliance.
tasks.output:
Implemented DeliveryService with receiveDelivery() method that:
1. Creates Delivery record in DB transaction
2. Posts StockTransaction for tank stock-in via StockTransactionService::append() with delivery_id sourceFK
3. Updates PurchaseOrder status (pending → partially_received → received) based on total liters delivered
4. Uses dependency injection for StockTransactionService
5. Includes create() method for manual entry without stock ledger

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement NozzleReadingService - compute liters sold, write stock + payment ledger
tasks.description: NozzleReadingService only has stub create(). Implement: compute liters sold from readings, write stock transaction ledger entries, write payment transaction ledger entries, handle reversals.
tasks.output:
Implemented NozzleReadingService with recordReading() method that:
1. Computes liters_sold = closing_reading - opening_reading
2. Computes amount = liters_sold * price_per_liter
3. Creates NozzleReading record in DB transaction
4. Posts StockTransaction for tank stock-out (negative quantity) via StockTransactionService::append() with nozzle_reading_id sourceFK
5. Includes create() for manual entry and getLatestReading() for sequential readings
6. Uses dependency injection for StockTransactionService

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement SaleService - orchestrate sale items, stock, payments
tasks.description: SaleService only has stub create(). Implement: orchestrate sale items, decrement stock via StockTransactionService, create payments via PaymentTransactionService, handle complex sale flows.
tasks.output:
Implemented SaleService with createSale() method that:
1. Creates Sale record with computed totals in DB transaction
2. Creates SaleItems for both product and fuel types (respects XOR constraint)
3. Posts StockTransaction for product stock-out via StockTransactionService with sale_item_id sourceFK
4. Posts PaymentTransaction for revenue (income) via PaymentTransactionService with sale_id sourceFK
4. Handles payment status (paid/partially_paid) and change calculation
5. Includes helper methods for product/fuel sale items
6. Uses dependency injection for StockTransactionService and PaymentTransactionService

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement StockAdjustmentService - write stock ledger entry
tasks.description: StockAdjustmentService only has stub. Implement: write stock ledger entry for adjustments, support all AdjustmentType enums, append-only compliance.
tasks.output:
Implemented StockAdjustmentService with recordAdjustment() method that:
1. Creates StockAdjustment record in DB transaction
2. Resolves polymorphic stockable (Tank or Product)
3. Posts StockTransaction via StockTransactionService::append() with stock_adjustment_id sourceFK (quantity can be positive or negative)
4. Supports all adjustment types: correction, spillage, evaporation, theft, return, other
5. Links to deep_reading_id for tank adjustments from dip readings
6. Uses dependency injection for StockTransactionService

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement DeepReadingService - record dip, compute variance
tasks.description: DeepReadingService only has stub. Implement: record dip reading, compute variance vs calculated stock, write to nozzle_readings.
tasks.output:
Implemented DeepReadingService with recordReading() method that:
1. Uses TankCalibrationService to interpolate calibrated volume from deep_cm using linear interpolation
2. Gets system stock from tank's calculated_stock (derived from stock_transactions)
3. Computes variance = calibrated_volume - system_stock
4. Creates DeepReading record with all computed values
5. Optionally creates correction StockAdjustment via StockAdjustmentService for non-zero variance
6. Includes getVarianceHistory() for reporting
7. Uses dependency injection for TankCalibrationService and StockAdjustmentService

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement AccountService - CRUD + derived balance from ledger
tasks.description: AccountService only has stub. Implement: CRUD + balance derived from ledger (payment_transactions + stock_transactions affecting account).
tasks.output:

1. createAccount() - create new account
2. updateAccount() - update details (prevents direct balance updates)

4. recordPayment() - records payment via PaymentTransactionService (income/expense)

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement ProductService - CRUD + PriceHistory dual-write
tasks.description: ProductService only has stub create(). Implement: CRUD + price update triggers PriceHistory dual-write (already done per backend_dev report - FuelTypeService has this pattern).
tasks.output:

tasks.subject: Phase 3: Implement PurchaseOrderService - CRUD + status transitions
tasks.description: PurchaseOrderService only has stub. Implement: CRUD + status transitions (draft → ordered → received → cancelled), stock ledger writes on receive.
tasks.output:
Implemented PurchaseOrderService with:
1. createPurchaseOrder() - creates PO with calculated total_amount, sets status to pending
2. updateStatus() - updates PO status (pending, partially_received, received, cancelled)
3. cancel() - cancels PO (only if pending and no deliveries)

7. getOutstandingAmount() - calculates total_amount - paid expenses

9. Status transitions handled; deliveries update status automatically (in DeliveryService)
